orders.detail: published == replay under the 0.1 bps correlated factor (10 ppm), not the stated default factor; the override token sets are deployment config, so this regime is INFERRED from the published value

not_verifiable: the correlated-token override sets and the usd reference token are autopilot deployment config, not published; the replay uses CIP-87's numbers plus a per-chain USDC default and marks any regime it had to infer (`inferred: true`)
a stale usd reference price (the autopilot keeps its last value when the reference token has no price in a cycle) is not observable from public data; the replay uses the price in this auction
usd reference token on bnb is ASSUMED (0x8ac76a51cc950d9822d68b83fe1ad97b32cd580d); it only matters where the bound binds

the CIP text defines the basis as the order's quote (net of volume fees); the implementation values the signed sell side (sell orders) or buy side (buy orders) at reference prices - the replay follows the implementation; the CIP's scaling to the executed fraction of a partial fill happens at penalty time and is not part of the published per-order cap
disclaimer: cow-certify is independent and not affiliated with CoW Protocol; this replay recomputes a rewards-accounting parameter from public data and reports differences, it does not adjudicate them.
